description: Classic Hangman: guess the hidden word letter by letter before the drawing is complete.

faqs.a: You get 6 wrong guesses: head, body, two arms and two legs. The 6th wrong guess ends the game.
faqs.q: How many wrong guesses do I get?

faqs.a: About 100 everyday English words across animals, food, sports, objects, nature and professions.
faqs.q: Where do the words come from?

faqs.a: Click “New word” any time for a fresh word and a clean gallows.

howto: A random word is picked and its category shown.
Wrong guesses draw the hangman, one part at a time.
Guess the word before 6 wrong guesses.
title: Hangman Game
